correctness.rationale: The line-graph equivalence converts a selected triangular-graph vertex set to edges H subset K_n. L(H) is bipartite precisely when H has maximum degree <=2 and only even cycles, i.e. its components are paths, isolated vertices and even cycles of length at least four. One can join endpoints of two paths, so maximality leaves at most one path; an even path of size >=4 can close to an allowed even cycle, whereas one path of odd size or size two cannot. Conversely all other omitted edges create forbidden degree three or odd cycle. The labeled exponential formula counts even cycles with EGF e^{-z²x²/4}(1-z²x²)^(-1/4); multiplying by an arbitrary path SET or the one permissible path gives the two displayed EGFs. Logarithmic differentiation produces c0=1,c1=0,4jc_j=sum_{i<=j-2}c_i and exact even/odd polynomials; singular coefficient ratio c_{m-1}/c_m ->1 gives 2/3. Independent direct adjacency enumeration for n=3,4,5 verified maximality and coefficients and an inspected exact finite component recurrence through 30 (not treated as unrestricted proof).
